from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Grid lines are the rows and columns dominated by their line color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if max(Counter(grid[r]).values()) >= 0.8 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][1] >= 0.8 * h]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid

    intersections = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols]
    line_color = Counter(intersections).most_common(1)[0][0]

    interiors = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ]
    fill = Counter(interiors).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            line.append(color if color != line_color and all(x == color for x in corners) else fill)
        out.append(line)
    return out

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    row_color = Counter(row_modes).most_common()[-1][0]
    col_color = Counter(col_modes).most_common()[-1][0]
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == row_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == col_color]

    # Keep only the separator lines containing some colored marker at a crossing.
    active_rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] != row_color for c in cols)]
    active_cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != col_color for r in rows)]
    if len(active_rows) >= 2:
        rows = active_rows
    if len(active_cols) >= 2:
        cols = active_cols

    row_set, col_set = set(rows), set(cols)
    interior = [
        grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in row_set
        for c in range(w) if c not in col_set
    ]
    fill = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            ]
            out_row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else fill)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
